$comment: Scoped to this repo on purpose. The daemon cold-indexes any repo it is asked about, and a
machine-wide hook would do that for every project you open, so this stays local until the
Sessions tab says the injection is earning its tokens here first.
shim.py is standard-library only, so plain python3 runs it; the daemon it talks to is the one
holding the model. Invoked through python3 rather than the file's executable bit because a
hook that cannot exec fails silently and looks identical to a hook that chose to skip.
The 5s timeout sits just above the shim's own 3s socket timeout, so the shim gives up first
and exits 0 rather than being killed mid-write.
